title: carapa mekongensis
intro: Carapa mekongensis, commonly known as the Mekong carapa, is a plant species belonging to the family Meliaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating fever, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The health benefits of Carapa mekongensis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can be useful in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Carapa mekongensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
